title: Add CSV export for invoices
body: Finance asked for a CSV export of invoices. Adds `widgets.export.to_csv`.
head: feat/invoice-csv-export

reviews.author: alice
reviews.body: A couple of things before this goes in.

reviews.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]
reviews.body: Copilot reviewed 1 out of 1 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Building rows with an f-string breaks as soon as a customer name has a comma in it (we have "Acme, Inc." in prod). Can we use the csv module so fields get quoted properly?

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Do voided invoices end up in this export? Finance only wants the live ones.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]
comments.body: `inv.amount` may be `None` here, and formatting `None` with `:.2f` will raise a `TypeError`. Consider guarding against missing amounts before formatting.
